sources.name: MangaHub (Alt)
sources.author: jakub
sources.desc: MangaHub (mangahub.io) for Paperback 0.8. v3.2.5: graceful error handling on all read methods (no more app-wide crashes on rate-limit / CF blocks); Settings UI with Refresh API key + Reset session buttons. AES-GCM decryption (netsky PR #123) is enabled automatically when the site serves encrypted pages.
